world.title: ‘Gets you up with a slap, puts you to sleep with a slap’: What flydubai co-pilot’s old posts reveal about his views
world.summary: Omani co-pilot Hamam al-Hammami's past online activity has been scrutinized following an analysis by The Telegraph, which reviewed over 2,000 posts linked to him. The investigation revealed controversial views expressed in his posts, prompting discussions about their implications. The findings have raised questions about his suitability for the role and the potential impact on the airline's reputation.

world.title: 15-Year-Old Picks Up Grenade During French Protest, Has Hand Blown Off
world.summary: A 15-year-old student in Lens, France, lost a hand after picking up a sting-ball grenade fired by police during nationwide protests over classroom conditions. The protests have disrupted lessons at numerous schools since last week. While some students have returned to classrooms, many remain involved in the demonstrations, highlighting ongoing concerns about educational environments in the country.

world.title: "There Was Big Mistake": What Oman Sources Told NDTV About flydubai Co-Pilot
world.summary: Omani sources informed NDTV that Hamam al-Hammami, the flydubai co-pilot who attacked Captain Smit Machchhar, had been barred from an aviation career in Oman due to concerns about his extremist interests. His identity has not been officially confirmed by UAE authorities or flydubai. The incident raises questions about the oversight of aviation personnel in the region.

business.title: Ampere Nexus EX+ launched at Rs 1.30 lakh
business.summary: Ampere has launched the Nexus EX+ electric scooter in India, priced at Rs 1.3 lakh (ex-showroom). This updated model features a more powerful 5kW motor, enhancing performance. Additionally, it includes an IP65-rated water-resistant charger for durability. Buyers can also opt for the Intellipack connected technology suite, providing advanced connectivity features for users.

business.title: Bajaj Finance kicks off up to Rs 17,500 cr fund raise; picks 3 banks & eyes November launch
business.summary: Bajaj Finance has initiated plans to raise up to Rs 17,500 crore, selecting three banks for the process. This follows its previous equity fund raise in 2023, where it secured Rs 10,000 crore through a combination of Qualified Institutional Placement (QIP) and warrants. The company aims for the capital raise to launch in November.

business.title: Honda XR300L, XR300 Rally Launched In India: Prices, Specs, Features
business.summary: Honda Motorcycle & Scooter India has launched the XR300L and XR300 Rally in India, priced at Rs 1.83 lakh and Rs 2.08 lakh (ex-showroom), respectively. These motorcycles aim to attract a diverse audience, including buyers of the Xpulse and Himalayan models. The launch comes as the segment experiences significant growth, reflecting increasing interest in adventure motorcycles.

technology.title: As October 5, 2026 marks the 15th Anniversary of Steve Jobs' death; here's the page that Apple has maintained in Jobs' memory since past 15 years
technology.summary: On October 5, 2026, Apple will commemorate the 15th anniversary of Steve Jobs' death, who passed away from pancreatic cancer at age 56 in 2011. Since then, Apple has maintained a dedicated page honoring his legacy. Jobs' influence remains significant in the tech industry, reflecting his lasting impact on innovation and design within the company and beyond.

technology.title: Introducing MOMENTUM 5 Series in India: Your Sound Revelation Starts Here
technology.summary: Sennheiser has launched the MOMENTUM 5 Wireless headphones and MOMENTUM True Wireless 5 in India. This new series enhances the acclaimed audio lineup while maintaining its signature sound quality and battery performance. Designed for modern audio enthusiasts, the MOMENTUM 5 series aims to elevate everyday listening experiences with user-focused improvements, marking a significant evolution in Sennheiser's offerings.

technology.title: One UI 9 will be my Galaxy S23's last update; I'm waiting to see if it's worth the pain
technology.summary: The Samsung Galaxy S23 will receive its final update with One UI 9. The user expresses reluctance to update immediately, citing a lack of compelling reasons. Despite owning a Galaxy S25+ as their main device, they have retained the S23, contemplating its potential use for a family friend. The article reflects on the diminishing value of timely updates.

sports.title: Hardik Pandya trade attracts renewed traction
sports.summary: Hardik Pandya is drawing renewed interest from IPL franchises, with at least one team reportedly making inquiries about the all-rounder. The 32-year-old is considered a high-value player when fit. However, a formal trade offer is not expected for another 3-4 weeks. The situation remains fluid as teams evaluate their options regarding the talented cricketer.

sports.title: 'The perception of Tamil Nadu needs to be changed': Yo Mahesh
sports.summary: Yo Mahesh, the head coach of Tamil Nadu, emphasizes the need to change perceptions about the state's cricketing legacy. In an exclusive interview, he addresses the team's 38-year Ranji Trophy drought and expresses his desire for players to move beyond past failures. Mahesh believes that the legacy side may have softened over the years, impacting current performance.

sports.title: 'India moved beyond him': DK's verdict on Shami
sports.summary: Dinesh Karthik assessed Mohammed Shami's prospects for an India comeback, indicating they are slim as the team has moved beyond him. He also expressed concerns regarding the future of ODI cricket, emphasizing the significant roles played by Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli. Karthik highlighted the potential challenges the team may face following their eventual retirements.

health.title: The human brain may not be one organ after all: Stanford study finds two systems dating back 550 million years
health.summary: A Stanford study indicates that the human brain may consist of two distinct systems originating from ancient nervous systems dating back 550 million years. This finding provides new insights into brain evolution and could inform future research on neurological conditions such as amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and spinal muscular atrophy (SMA), highlighting the complexity of brain development.

health.title: Creatine moves into weight management
health.summary: New research indicates that creatine may aid in weight management by promoting lower body fat and increased lean mass. A Texas A&M study found participants gained lean tissue while significantly reducing fat mass. The creatine market has surpassed $1.7 billion, experiencing a rapid annual growth rate of 26.2%, presenting new opportunities for food and beverage brands.

health.title: New Weapons In The Fight Against Cancer: AI Technology To Detect Cancer Stem Cells Early
health.summary: Scientists have developed AI technology aimed at early detection of cancer stem cells, addressing issues of cancer recurrence and damage to healthy cells during chemotherapy. However, these findings are currently limited to research and laboratory stages. The safety, efficacy, and clinical utility of this technology will need to be confirmed through extensive clinical trials on patients.

science.title: Can Boeing win back NASA’s trust with its Starliner?
science.summary: Boeing's Starliner faced helium leaks and thruster issues during its 2024 crewed mission to the International Space Station (ISS), resulting in an extended nine-month stay for two astronauts. This situation has raised concerns about the spacecraft's reliability and Boeing's ability to regain NASA's trust. The company is working to address these technical challenges for future missions.

science.title: Stanford scientists find brain develops from 2 distinct cell groups
science.summary: A Stanford study has identified that the human brain develops from two distinct cell groups: one for the front (forebrain and midbrain) and another for the back (hindbrain). This finding suggests that two ancient nervous systems merged over 550 million years ago. The research was published in the journal Nature Neuroscience, contributing to our understanding of brain evolution.

science.title: Will dark energy rip the Universe apart? Scientists reveal a shocking new clue
science.source: Futura, le média qui explore le monde
science.summary: Scientists are investigating the ultimate fate of the Universe, focusing on dark energy's role in its expansion. Edwin Hubble's 1930s discovery of cosmic expansion, along with Georges Lemaître's application of Einstein's general relativity, has shaped current cosmological theories. New clues suggest that dark energy may lead to significant changes, potentially ripping the Universe apart or causing it to freeze.

entertainment.title: Vijay Deverakonda admits he is ‘possessive’ about wife Rashmika Mandanna, explains why it has nothing to do with jealousy: ‘Her career, health, happiness, safety, everything is important to me’
entertainment.summary: Vijay Deverakonda has expressed that he is possessive about his wife, actress Rashmika Mandanna. He clarified that this possessiveness is not rooted in jealousy but stems from his concern for her career, health, happiness, and safety. Deverakonda emphasized the importance of these aspects in their relationship, highlighting his supportive nature towards her personal and professional life.

entertainment.title: No Price Hike For Ranabaali
entertainment.summary: The producers of the film Ranabaali, featuring Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna, announced that there will be no increase in ticket prices in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. This clarification aims to address concerns among fans and audiences regarding potential price hikes for the film's release, ensuring affordability for viewers in these regions.

entertainment.title: Janhvi Kapoor Makes A Case For Fall Fashion In A Mini Skirt And Fur Jacket At Miu Miu Paris Show
entertainment.summary: Janhvi Kapoor showcased her fall fashion at the Miu Miu Paris Show, wearing a coordinated mini skirt and fur jacket. Known for her distinctive style, Kapoor frequently experiments with different silhouettes, blending current trends with her personal flair. Her appearance at the event further emphasizes her status as a fashion icon, consistently making bold choices in her wardrobe.
